session_notes: Depth-4 tree initially built (then reset). Strong B12 evidence ('Bu daha iyi açık ara'). Test switch with observation. Asks about Precision metric. Asks 'MCR mi daha önemli yoksa sensitivity mi' — B13 candidate but teacher explanation followed immediately.

B12.note: After comparing CTR rows, David used explicit comparative language naming a clear winner. B12-D1 candidate; confidence High.

B13.note: David asked 'MCR mi daha önemli yoksa sensitivity mi?' This is a trade-off framing question — potentially B13-D2. However, teacher explanation (Merve) immediately followed. No post-scaffold independent application recorded. Scored not_observed because qualifying criterion (unprompted metric integration + consequence framing) not met before scaffold.

B10.quote: Bu group için daha fazla bölmem gerekiyor.
B10.note: Targeted the impure node explicitly for child split — B10-A2 confirmed. Then compared two child split options — B10-D1 confirmed.
